blocks.text: 1 Samuel 6 contains 21 verses. It opens with: And the ark of Jehovah was in the country of the Philistines seven months. It concludes with: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim, saying, The Philistines have brought back the ark of Jehovah; come ye down, and fetch it up to you. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The ark narrative rejects Israel's use of the ark as a guarantee of victory and portrays the LORD judging Philistine gods and communities without an Israelite army rescuing the ark.
